nodes.label: Impeccable: Live (Interactive Browser Variant Mode)
nodes.rationale: Pick elements in the browser, get AI variants hot-swapped via HMR. Identity-first: ~90% of sessions are default mode (variation within existing brand), not departure mode. Three variants must vary along different primary axes. Parameters (0-4 per variant) expose tunable axes without regeneration.
